title: Quarantine Bay and Isolation Row Rates: Repair Estimates & Appointments Lot Notice
content:
**Notice to the lot and the desk.** On a Repair Estimates & Appointments storage statement, the storage daily rate follows how the vehicle is held:

- a vehicle with high-voltage damage recorded on the booking that arrived on a network-arranged tow, a tow-in charge having been posted on the booking whether or not it has since been settled, came in unable to be driven and is held in the quarantine bay at **85.00 USD per day**;
- a vehicle with high-voltage damage recorded on the booking and no tow-in charge ever posted on the booking was driven or carried in and is held in the isolation row at **70.00 USD per day**.

For a vehicle with no high-voltage damage recorded on the booking, neither the quarantine bay rate nor the isolation row rate applies.

**Records that decide the rate**

| High-voltage damage recorded on the booking | Tow-in charge ever posted on the booking | Held in | Storage daily rate |
|---|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes (paid, waived or still open) | Quarantine bay | 85.00 USD |
| Yes | No | Isolation row | 70.00 USD |
| No | Either | Neither | Not set by this notice |

**Basis questions**

- *The tow-in charge on the booking was paid in full weeks ago. Does the vehicle still count as towed in?* Yes: what decides is that a tow-in charge was posted on the booking, whether or not it has since been settled.
- *The caller says the vehicle is a hybrid but the booking records no high-voltage damage.* The rate follows the high-voltage damage recorded on the booking; with none recorded, neither rate of this notice applies.
- *Hypothetical figure:* 4 billed days in the quarantine bay are billed at 85.00 USD per day; 4 billed days in the isolation row at 70.00 USD per day.
